summary.text: Mai Xiong is the Democratic state representative for Michigan House District 13, which she has held since April 30, 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her as a business owner who was born in Thailand.

paragraphs.text: Mai Xiong was born in Loei, Thailand, and earned a bachelor's degree from the College for Creative Studies in 2007, according to Ballotpedia.
She is also a graduate of Harvard Kennedy School and Michigan State University, both in 2022, and her career experience includes being a business owner.

In a 2023 Ballotpedia survey, Xiong said she was born in a refugee camp in Thailand and arrived in the United States with her family in 1987, when she was 3 years old, and received her U.S. citizenship in 1997.
She said she attended Macomb Community College before earning her Bachelor of Fine Arts, and that she and her husband have four children in Warren Consolidated Schools.
In that survey, Xiong said she was first elected to the Macomb County Board of Commissioners in 2020 and was serving her second term.
She took office in the state House on April 30, 2024, succeeding Lori Stone.
She listed ending the retirement tax on seniors, living wages, reproductive rights, investment in teachers and classrooms, public transportation, and clean air and water as her policy priorities.
